profile.what: Indian listed arm of Bayer AG's Crop Science division: crop protection (insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, seed treatment, biologicals) and hybrid corn seeds (DEKALB); also trades rice seed and acts as agent for group seed products. One reportable segment, 'Agri Care'.
profile.plants: Himatnagar (Gujarat, crop protection formulation), Silvassa (DNH) and Shamirpet (Telangana, corn seed); 5 plants incl. R&D, 20 warehouses, 30 offices; 25 states / 4 UTs; 13 export countries
profile.distribution: 97% of sales through dealers/distributors; 3,534 distributors billed in FY26 (3,940 in FY25); top-10 distributors 13% of sales (7% in FY25); Better Life Farming partner network 1,500-1,600+ centres reaching ~600,000 farmers
profile.people: 961 permanent employees, 113 permanent workers, ~1,730 contract staff (Mar-2026)
profile.rnd: R&D spend Rs 116 cr in FY26 (2.04% of revenue; capital Rs 38.6 cr, recurring Rs 77.4 cr), mostly corn breeding (Shamirpet) and field trials; new molecules come from Bayer AG
profile.src: AR FY26 BRSR and directors' report

cashAndTreasury.note: Screener 'Cash Equivalents' (1,422) + 'Investments' (57) match the reported cash, so no deposits sit in other assets. Customer advances Rs 202 cr and Rs 80 cr advance for the flubendiamide divestment were inside Mar-26 liabilities; the year-end cash is seasonally high (receivables low, payables high).

q1fy27.oneOffWhat: Gain on divesting marketing rights for formulated products containing flubendiamide to Tagros Chemicals India (agreement 20-Apr-2026; Rs 80 cr advance received in Mar-2026)
q1fy27.patExOneOffNote: GAM: Rs 321.6 cr less Rs 63.9 cr x (1 - 25.2%) = ~Rs 274 cr, about 2% below Q1FY26's Rs 279 cr
commentary: Revenue down 4% on weather and changing market dynamics; corn seed sales held up although overall acreage declined (Simon Wiebusch, MD & CEO).
PAT growth from higher gross margins (pricing actions and product mix) plus the divestment gain (Vinit Jindal, CFO); other operating expenses rose.
Focus on working capital: inventory optimisation and stronger collections.
Risks named: weather variability incl. possible El Nino, geopolitics.
q1fy27.src: Screener quarterly (standalone); company release via Global Agriculture (8-Aug-2026); Sahi (26-Aug-2026)

guidance.said: High single digit to low double digit revenue growth a year (volume and price), from FY25 base, driven by core crop protection launches and 'a continued doubling of our corn seeds portfolio'
~100bp margin improvement a year for the first 2-3 years from the FY25 base (EBITDA 12.6% on Screener); margins 'hit rock bottom' in FY25; aspiration, not a promise
Mid-single digit at best after H1 +3% (Q1 +17%, Q2 -11%)
Dividend distribution 'remains intact' despite the FY25 earnings dip (Rs 90 interim)
Corn seeds ~doubled in five years (CAGR 15-16% vs crop protection <6%); expect to double again; India corn demand 2x by 2030 (70 MMT)
Over-proportionally buying from strong-currency countries; aim to move crop-protection sourcing towards ~50:50 India/Asia over time ('Simon shoots into the air')
guidance.outcome: Purchases from Bayer AG Rs 1,341 cr in FY26 vs Rs 2,421 cr in FY25

fy26CropProtection: Etciostar (pre-emergent rice herbicide for direct-seeded rice)
Felujit and Spintor (biological insecticide) shown in Nov-2025 deck
pipeline: Xivana Smart (fruit and vegetable, 'beginning of next year' subject to MRLs)
Plenexos (new insecticide, Bayer 'global blockbuster', 'next couple of years')
Short-stature corn / Preceon (advanced pipeline; subject to regulatory approval)
launches.newProductShare: Products launched in the last three years ~one-sixth of FY25 crop-protection sales; Council Activ (FY23 launch) now a top-2/3 product
launches.topBrands: DEKALB (corn), Roundup (glyphosate), Nativo, Laudis, Council Activ
launches.divestments: Bayer has been divesting older generic products (profit on divestment Rs 26.8 cr FY25, Rs 22.3 cr FY26; flubendiamide marketing rights to Tagros, Rs 63.9 cr gain in Q1FY27)

relatedParty.rationale: 'The technical know-how, patented formulations and specialized services are owned by Bayer AG and cannot be procured from any third party' (AGM notice)
relatedParty.src: AR FY26 note 42 and AGM notice item 4

goToMarket: From FY26 a new model in rice-dominated (East) geographies: exclusive partners and Better Life Farming centres serve farmers instead of Bayer's own field force; manpower focused on profitable territories; 'margin per head' not 'turnover per head'. Sales commission rose to Rs 88.9 cr (Rs 21.3 cr FY25). Severance/one-offs mostly taken in FY25.
goToMarketSrc: Investor Meet Nov-2025; AR FY26 note 31
fy25Problems: FY25 EPS fell 23% to Rs 126: input costs up, Chinese prices limited price increases, 'unprecedented' receivable collection issues (ECL provision Rs 78 cr) and severance costs from the new operating model.
fy25ProblemsSrc: Investor Meet transcript Nov-2025; AR FY26 note 31

impliedExemptAgriIncome.note: GAM inference: tax effect / 25.168%. Income from producing corn seed is claimed as agricultural income (tax-exempt); a proxy for seed-business profit.

tax.dispute: Rs 233 cr of contingent direct-tax liability relates to the agricultural-income exemption, pending before the Supreme Court, High Court and CIT(A)

contingentLiabilities.endosulfanSuit: Kerala civil suit (2018) against Bayer and 15 other makers, jointly and severally, for Rs 161.7 cr of compensation paid to endosulfan victims; Bayer denies liability

history.event: Bayer group starts Indian operations with an agrochemical manufacturing unit; the company is incorporated (CIN L24210MH1958PLC011173)
Share buybacks: equity capital falls from Rs 37 cr (FY15) to Rs 34 cr (FY18)

Monsanto India Ltd merged into Bayer CropScience (NCLT Mumbai order 13-Sep-2019; 2 BCSL shares for every 3 Monsanto India shares; Monsanto brands such as DEKALB corn and Roundup kept); equity capital rises to Rs 45 cr (4.49 cr shares)
Dividends of Rs 115-150 a share, 77-105% of EPS; revenue Rs 4,261 cr (FY21) to Rs 5,140 cr (FY23)
Global destocking and Chinese prices: FY24 revenue -1%, FY25 EPS -23% (input costs, receivable write-offs, restructuring)
Investor meet: 3-5 year aspiration of high-single to low-double digit growth and ~100bp a year margin gain; corn to double
Flubendiamide marketing rights sold to Tagros (Rs 63.9 cr gain in Q1FY27)
FY26: revenue +4% to Rs 5,675 cr, PAT +21% to Rs 689 cr; Rs 60 final dividend (total Rs 150)
Q1FY27 revenue -4%, PAT +15% incl. one-off; AGM approves Bayer AG transactions up to Rs 3,500 cr for FY28; Ravi Kirpalani named chairman from 12-Sep-2026

regulation.glyphosate: Government notification (Oct-2022) restricting glyphosate use to licensed pest-control operators is challenged in the Delhi High Court; the government said it would not implement it until petitions are decided. Bayer sells glyphosate as Roundup (part of 'Others', ~17% of FY25 revenue with exports and traded seeds).
regulation.paraquat: Draft nationwide ban Jul-2026, final 22-Sep-2026 (from SUMICHEM fact base); removes a competing non-selective herbicide
regulation.pesticideBill: Pesticides Management Bill 2025 draft (comments to 2-Feb-2026) to replace the 1968 Act
regulation.gmCorn: India does not allow GM corn cultivation; Bayer's traits (and Preceon short corn) need approval; possible duty-free US corn imports for ethanol discussed in 2025 (management: 'still speculation')
regulation.src: SUMICHEM fact base (Delhi HC, paraquat, bill); Investor Meet Nov-2025 (GM corn)
